sn22.102:1.1: Tatra voca || || Aniccasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati sabbaṃ bhavarāgam pariyādiyati sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānam pariyādiyati samūhanti || ||
sn22.102:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye kasako mahānaṅgalena kasanto sabbāni mūlasantānakāni sampadālento kasati || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam bhavarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānaṃ samūhanti || ||
sn22.102:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave pabbajalāyako pabbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti niddhunāti nicchodeti || Evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā || pe || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ambapiṇḍiyā
sn22.102:4.1: vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni tatra ambāni vaṇṭapaṭibaddhāni sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā || pa || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave
sn22.102:5.1: kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā kūṭaṃ tāsam aggam akkhāyati || || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā || pa || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave
sn22.102:6.1: ye keci mūlagandhā kāḷānusārī tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave
sn22.102:7.1: ye keci sāragandhā lohitacandanaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave
sn22.102:8.1: ye keci pupphagandhā vassikaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave
sn22.102:9.1: ye keci kuḍḍarājāno sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā bhavanti || rājā tesaṃ cakkavatti aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pe || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci
sn22.102:10.1: tārakarūpānam pabhā sabbā tā candimapabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti solasiṃ candappabhā tāsam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave
sn22.102:11.1: saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabham abbhussukkamāno sabbam ākāsagatam tamagatam abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca || evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam bhavarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānaṃ samūhanti || ||
sn22.102:12.1: Katham bhavitā ca bhikkhave aniccasaññā katham bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || pe || sabbam asmimānam samūhanti || || Iti rūpam iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo || || Iti vedanā || || Iti saññā || || Iti saṅkhāra || || Iti viññāṇam iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti || || Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā evam bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam bhavarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānaṃ samūhantīti || || Pupphavaggo samatto ||
sn22.102:13.0: Tatra uddānaṃ || Nadī || Pupphañ ca Pheṇaṃ ca || Gomayañ ca Nakhāsikhaṃ || Suddhikam dve ca gaddulā || Vāsijaṭam Aniccatā ti || Vaggo Majjhimapaññāsako samatto || ||
sn22.102:14.0: Tassa Majjhimapaññāsakassa vagguddānaṃ || Upāyo Arahanto ca Khajjanī Therasambhayaṃ Pupphavaggena paññāsadutiyo tena vuccati || ||
